user.title: Connect to Nextcloud
user.description: Enter the URL of your Nextcloud instance and how you want to authenticate.

data_description.auth_method: Use a user + app password for full access, or a public share link shared by the Shopping List app.
data_description.url: For example cloud.example.com. A full share link can be pasted here as well — it is recognised automatically.

account.title: Nextcloud account
account.description: Sign in with your Nextcloud username and an app password (Nextcloud → Personal settings → App passwords).

share.title: Public share link
share.description: Paste the share link of a shopping list (or just the token). The link password is only needed for protected shares.

lists.title: Choose shopping lists
lists.description: Select the lists you want to import into Home Assistant. You can change this later in the integration options.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Nextcloud rejected the stored credentials. Please enter them again.

error.app_not_installed: The Shopping List app is not installed or enabled on this server
error.share_not_found: Share link not found or expired
error.share_password_required: This share link requires a password

abort.already_configured: This Nextcloud account is already configured

init.title: HANC Shopping List options
init.description: Choose which lists to sync and how often to poll Nextcloud.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant asks Nextcloud for updates, between 10 and 600 seconds.

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Adds an item to one of the synced shopping lists.

entity_id.name: List
entity_id.description: The todo entity of the shopping list.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the item, for example "Milk".

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: Quantity of the item, for example "2". Defaults to 1.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit of the item, for example "kg".

area.name: Shop area
area.description: Name of an existing shop area (aisle) of that list, for example "Supermarket".

checked.name: Checked
checked.description: Add the item already checked off.

clear_checked.name: Clear checked items
clear_checked.description: Deletes all checked items from the list. Only available when connected with an account.

entity_id.name: List
entity_id.description: The todo entity of the shopping list.

uncheck_all.name: Uncheck all items
uncheck_all.description: Unchecks every item on the list. Only available when connected with an account.
